title: Elizabeth Targ's death from glioblastoma
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Elizabeth Targ's death from glioblastoma, about 2000s at an unknown place, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: She was looking at geoblastto which are brain tumors, very deadly brain tumors. And she was working with healers to heal the the geoblastto tumor when she contracted one herself
